lines.t: Yeah…
All I have, all I have… yeah it’s Yours.
Whole world in my hands, still it ain’t mine, it’s Yours.
Then the light broke in, all pride got torn,
Now I know the truth — all I have is Yours.
Every breath that I take came from grace untold,
Every win that I claim, every chain of gold.
All fades out when the fire restores,
In knowing You, I possess all things, Lord.
All I have is Yours, no second source,
All I know is Yours, You the full force.
From the highs to the lows, ain’t nothing void,
In knowing You, I possess all things.
They wonder why I move like I already won,
Spirit got the code, ain’t no need to run.
Humbled in the glow, no fake decor,
Just eternal peace — all I have is Yours.
Kingdom mindset, riches of the unseen,
No flex, just faith where the soul stays clean.
Woke in the Word, see the truth restored,
In knowing You, I possess all things, Lord.
Hands up, I’m free from the force,
Heart locked in, yeah, all I have is Yours.
From the dirt to the stars, the promise roars,
In knowing You, I possess all things, Lord.
All I have is Yours, no second source,
All I know is Yours, You the full force.
From the highs to the lows, ain’t nothing void,
In knowing You, I possess all things.
Yeah… all I have… is Yours.
All I have… yeah, all I have… is Yours.
